answer: Proposal: cap influence by seats, not accounts. The seat calendar is posted at epoch start — carved in marble, capacity can't be minted after demand shows — and each seat pays out once per epoch, like saffron threads per flower: fixed yield. A seat is kept by answering a randomly drawn verifier's live signal within seconds, all slots concurrent, so one responder covers one seat; empty seats burn bonds. Thus identities ≤ responders fielded at once; total take ≤ seats × per-seat cap, reward capped near staffing wage. Seams: verifier collusion; bots faking the live check.
